name: Redridge Rendezvous
summary: In Lakeshire, promising Alliance rogues train for dangerous work under seasoned operatives. SI:7 sends them east from Stormwind’s intelligence headquarters to prepare for the field.

sections.title: A Measure of Survival
sections.body: Renzik 'The Shiv', SI:7’s second-in-command in Stormwind, knows that untrained rogues rarely survive dangerous operations. Sending raw recruits into hostile territory brings casualties instead of intelligence. So SI:7 sends promising agents east to the Redridge Mountains. There, Lucius trains them among Lakeshire’s docks.

sections.title: Eyes in Lakeshire
sections.body: Lakeshire gives Lucius good ground for clandestine training. Gnolls and Blackrock orcs threaten the frontier town. Its piers let him test a rogue’s stealth, reflexes, and lockpicking without drawing the notice of townspeople or guards.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Redridge Rendezvous?
faq.answer: Renzik 'The Shiv', a goblin spymaster in Stormwind’s Old Town, gives the assignment from SI:7 headquarters to rogues who report to intelligence command.
Lucius waits along Lakeshire’s wooden docks in the Redridge Mountains, among local loafers and fishermen by the water.

faq.q: Why does SI:7 send rogues to Redridge?
faq.answer: Renzik considers inexperienced rogues unfit for dangerous intelligence work. In Lakeshire, Lucius sharpens their rough edges and tests skills such as pickpocketing and lockpicking under frontier conditions.

faq.q: What comes after completing Redridge Rendezvous?
faq.answer: Reporting to Lucius leads to training exercises at Alther's Mill, where the agent tests stealth and manual dexterity.

faq.q: Is this quest available to classes other than rogues?
faq.answer: No. Redridge Rendezvous is for Alliance rogues, as part of their SI:7 field training.

faq.q: Why does Renzik work for Stormwind intelligence?
aliases: why is a goblin in si7
faq.answer: Though a goblin, Renzik 'The Shiv' is a trusted lieutenant of Spymaster Mathias Shaw. He oversees operative intake and training from within SI:7’s stronghold.

angles.text: As a rogue, you begin formal SI:7 field work here. You move from backstreet thievery to calculated state espionage.
As an Alliance member, you see Stormwind’s clandestine arm reach outer settlements such as Lakeshire, where quiet operatives are stationed.
